display.purpose: Step and shortlist headings, uppercase. 2rem at 420px and below, 3rem from 760px, 4rem in the wide program column.

program-number.purpose: Two-digit entry numbers in the person's ink; 1.5rem at 420px and below.

body-small.purpose: The why line (62ch max), buttons and chips.

label.purpose: Form labels, legends, step names, disclosure summaries.

program-label.purpose: Uppercase whose-taste label and New pick tag; the date/people/mood line uses it at 700 and 0.8125rem.

note.purpose: Muted field notes, film notes, mood descriptions, tagline.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Colour and border transitions on buttons, fields, chips, moods, dropzone, chevron.

motion.name: ease-print
motion.purpose: The printing-in of a swapped pick.

motion.name: register
motion.purpose: The overprint impression of a shared swapped pick settles into register.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink action; full-width as each step's main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; background: var(--ink, #1c1c22); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #1c1c22); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--paper, #f3f4f6); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-hover, #3a3a45); border-color: var(--ink-hover, #3a3a45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1c1c22); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ink outline for the alternative action; fills with ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #1c1c22); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink, #1c1c22); color: var(--paper, #f3f4f6); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1c1c22); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Underlined muted text for the least action: Remove, Undo, Read more.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square field on Clean Sheet; the border turns ink on focus.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--panel, #ffffff); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #d1d3d9); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #595964); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #595964); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); outline: none; }

components.name: Service Chips
components.description: Multi-select chips; selected inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 9px 14px; background: var(--panel, #ffffff); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #d1d3d9); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #1c1c22); border-color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); color: var(--paper, #f3f4f6); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1c1c22); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mood Option

components.css: .ds-moods { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-mood { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--panel, #ffffff); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #d1d3d9); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-mood strong { display: block; font-weight: 700; } .ds-mood small { display: block; color: var(--muted, #595964); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-mood:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); } .ds-mood[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #1c1c22); border-color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); color: var(--paper, #f3f4f6); } .ds-mood[aria-pressed="true"] small { color: var(--paper, #f3f4f6); opacity: 0.8; } .ds-mood:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1c1c22); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Step Tracker
components.description: Masthead steps with circled tabular numbers; the current step fills with ink.
components.css: .ds-steps { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 10px; background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted, #595964); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); } .ds-step:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; } .ds-step[aria-current="step"] { color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); } .ds-step-n { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-step[aria-current="step"] .ds-step-n { background: var(--ink, #1c1c22); border-color: var(--ink, #1c1c22); color: var(--paper, #f3f4f6); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1c1c22); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Ink bar with a quiet paper action; the only element that lifts.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 4px 16px; background: var(--ink, #1c1c22); border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); color: var(--paper, #f3f4f6); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-toast-action { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 0; background: none; border: none; color: var(--paper, #f3f4f6); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast-action:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-toast-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--paper, #f3f4f6); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The Shortlist is set like a neighbourhood repertory cinema's two-colour risograph program. A cool off-white sheet (a near-black sheet in dark mode) carries near-black ink. Two riso inks carry one meaning each: fluorescent pink is the first person, blue the second, and where they overprint, purple means "Both of you". Ink-black does the work of the page: actions, selection, the current step, the rules that divide it. Nothing is coloured for decoration.

Structure comes from printed rules rather than boxes: 2px ink rules head each section and the masthead, 1.5px rules head each program entry, hairlines divide facts and lists. Corners are square (2px at most), surfaces are flat, and the only shadow belongs to a transient toast. One variable grotesque, Archivo, runs across its width axis: condensed heavy capitals for headings, the wordmark and program numbers; normal width for everything you read and operate.

Density is calm. The setup steps are a narrow centred column of ruled sections; the shortlist widens into a program, numbered entries in the person's ink with a poster, title, the reason for the pick and a hairline facts row. Motion is limited to short colour transitions and one authored moment: a swapped-in pick prints into place.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks plus their overprint, each tied to exactly one person or to both.
Ink-black for every action and every selected state.
Ruled sections, never rounded cards; flat paper, no surface shadows.
One variable grotesque: condensed heavy caps to announce, normal width to read.
Light and dark follow the device; both are first-class printings of the same program.

rules.name: The One Ink, One Person Rule
rules.body: Pink is the first person, blue the second, purple both. An ink appears only where it identifies whose a thing is; it never decorates, never marks state, never fills a button.

rules.name: The Black Does the Work Rule
rules.body: Every action and every selection is ink-black on paper, or paper on ink-black. Selection is never shown in a person's ink.

rules.name: The Real Overprint Rule
rules.body: "Both of you" is printed, not picked from a swatch: two impressions slightly off register, blended so their overlap lands on the purple.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Condensed heavy capitals announce (headings, wordmark, numbers, poster fallbacks); normal width does everything you read or operate. Nothing in between is condensed below 85%.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Anything counted or rated (program numbers, step numbers, counts, ratings, facts) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing printed on the page casts a shadow. Only the toast, which floats above the sheet, may lift.

dos: Do tie each ink to exactly one meaning: pink first person, blue second person, purple "Both of you".
Do show every action and every selected state in ink-black, inverted to paper text.
Do divide with rules: 2px ink for sections and the masthead, 1.5px for program entries, 1px hairlines for facts and lists.
Do keep controls square-cornered (2px) with 1.5px borders and a 44px minimum touch height.
Do set headings, the wordmark and program numbers in Archivo condensed (68 to 70%) at 850 to 900 in capitals, and everything operable at normal width.
Do print "Both of you" as a real overprint of two impressions slightly off register.
Do design light and dark together; both follow the device.
Do honour reduced motion by turning off every animation and transition.
donts: Don't use a person's ink for buttons, selection, hover or status.
Don't box content in rounded cards or give printed surfaces a shadow; only the toast lifts.
Don't fall back to a streaming-app poster grid; picks are numbered program entries.
Don't bring back the cream ground, Georgia serif and forest-green palette the program replaced.
Don't add a second typeface; Archivo's width axis carries the contrast.
Don't add motion beyond short colour transitions and the printing-in of a swapped pick.
